summary.text: Banks Helfrich is the Democratic candidate for the Florida House of Representatives, District 25, in the November 3, 2026 general election, against Republican incumbent Taylor Yarkosky.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a native Floridian and a South Lake County resident who teaches farming and sustainability.

paragraphs.text: Helfrich ran for the same seat in 2022 as a candidate with no party affiliation and lost to Taylor Yarkosky, 66.0% to 34.0%.
Ballotpedia lists him among the withdrawn or disqualified candidates for the District 25 race in 2024.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Helfrich listed his policy interests as property insurance, property tax reform, first-time home buyers and affordable housing, special needs populations, agriculture, and the preservation of Florida's natural beauty.
He said his campaign messages included a plan to make Florida affordable, the preservation and conservation of the state's natural beauty, and a plan to lower grocery costs.
